title: Note: those chips were leftover test agents

text: Each chip was a Claude session Servex kept open after today's proofs — not for you to talk to. I stopped all eleven; the strip is empty now. Clicking one showed the raw token stream inline, which was an interim and is wrong. On AI 2 a running agent is a card like everything else: what it is doing in a sentence, its result when it lands, its transcript one click away on its own page — never pushed into the middle of yours.
